candidates.change_summary: Return the negation of the internal _paused flag instead of its value.
Always return true regardless of the internal _paused state.
Always return false regardless of the internal _paused state.
Delete the assignment of lrtConfig so updateLRTConfig no longer changes the stored lrtConfig value.
Remove the zero-address check so lrtConfig can be set to address(0), which is observable via the stored lrtConfig value.
Set lrtConfig to a zero-address cast instead of the provided argument, changing the stored value after the call.
Check the MANAGER role instead of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE in onlyLRTAdmin, so a different set of callers can pass the guard and reach updateLRTConfig.
Invert the role check condition in onlyLRTAdmin so it reverts when the caller HAS the admin role, blocking legitimate admins from updating the config.
